join_ambient_when: you have something worth adding, someone would enjoy it, or a link or topic genuinely interests you
stay_quiet_when: people are talking to each other and you would only be acknowledging
notes: Custos owns this file. There is no fixed cap on how much you speak or reach out (Hal removed it on 2026-09-09); your judgment and this file are the moderation. group_stance and the join/stay-quiet lines steer the responder; min_gap_seconds (how soon the social thinker may run again after a conversation turn), wake_interval_seconds (its periodic check), initiate_after_hours (when it is nudged to start a conversation with someone) and unsolicited_per_day (how many messages the social thinker may send on its own initiative per day; replies to fresh messages are never counted) steer the social thinker. The harness never lets the social thinker double-text: a conversation where you spoke last and nobody answered is closed to it until a reply arrives or initiate_after_hours pass. Edit and the next turn uses the new values.
